title: Pseudoconvex Problems in Operational Decision Systems: Algorithms for Joint Learning and Optimization
summary: We consider joint optimization and learning problems arising in real-time decision systems. While most existing work focuses primarily on convex, revenue-based objectives, we extend this line of research to multi-objective formulations. In energy systems, for instance, we incorporate metrics such as renewable penetration and generation costs. Our key focus, however, is on a class of problems with a pseudoconvex structure - a natural relaxation of convexity.
